verdict.rationale: Trello publishes a REST API reference on developer.atlassian.com covering Batch, Search and Webhooks, plus guides on API keys and authorization. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and the probed OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
